quest.title: Uninvited Guests
quest.description: Something seems to be bothering Wangshu Inn's Huai'an...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Agh, I must think of something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. *sigh* I'd rather not talk about it.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Lately, business at the inn has been getting better and better, and we've had more people coming to stay.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Some people are looking for a peaceful time alone, while others bring their families over on trips.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: The booming business is a good thing, of course, but the fact remains that many monsters roam the nearby areas.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: If some child out at play or senior folk out on a stroll were to run into those creatures...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: To prevent such incidents from occurring, I have to go out and chase monsters around the inn away.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: But I am just one man, and they are many...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you lend me a hand? You will be well-paid, I assure you!

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: I'm counting on you, in any case. I noticed that there were various monster encampments about with dangerous creatures within them.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Also, another group of monsters tiptoed up near the inn and even set up camp there...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: You know what? You can leave the more dangerous ones to me. Just help me to clear out the monsters surrounding the inn.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: We'll meet up back here once all the monsters have been driven out.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: *sigh* These monsters really are a problem...

choices.text: I mean, you're pretty good yourself, aren't you?

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Me? Well... Thank you for the praise, but I'm just passable.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: And even so, I cannot fight them all by myself.

talks.objective: Go to the monster camp and defeat them

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, not a single clue in sight. Who defeated all these monsters? Was it... another adventurer?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But since these monsters have been defeated, let's just go back to Huai'an and tell him the news.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Oh, it's you.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I encountered these monsters by chance and defeated them.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: This area is not safe. So...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Right. I have other matters to attend to. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: You're back. Agh, those monsters were really hard to deal with...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You beat them all?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Hahaha, that's right. It took quite a lot of work, you know? Ah, I'm just not the young fighter I used to be.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I suppose you've defeated the ones on your end as well, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the monster camp...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: They were all defeated... But there was not a soul in the camp?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: That's very strange. Did some passing adventurer defeat them?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, thanks for patrolling the area on my behalf. Please take these.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: You're back. Agh, those monsters were really hard to deal with...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You beat them all?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Hahaha, that's right. It took quite a lot of work, you know? Ah, I'm just not the young fighter I used to be.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I suppose you've defeated the ones on your end as well, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Xiao...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: So he did it? But why would he...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Eh. I'm not going to second-guess him.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, thanks for patrolling the area on my behalf. Please take these.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? The monsters here have all been beaten up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this place is a complete mess...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happened here? Let's check this area out. We might find some clues!
